falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern expected a higher low formation; a break below this level invalidates the structural support thesis and confirms distribution rather than accumulation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 25 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The blowoff score of 40 suggested controlled volatility; sustained VIX elevation above 25 indicates panic selling and systemic stress, contradicting the bottoming pattern's implied volatility compression

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops more than 40 basis points from current level within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A rapid flight-to-quality rally of this magnitude signals recession/depression repricing, which would invalidate the cyclical bottom call as it implies fundamental economic deterioration rather than a technical market bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
